proposal.reason: Primary change is in transport/p2p IPC registration: it now registers and maps full multi-segment physical ranges, propagates segment metadata, and updates P2P proxy register/deregister flows for correct replay/lifecycle behavior. Add memory because alloc/free helpers in alloc.h were substantively changed to unmap/free multi-segment HG allocations with segment-aware validation and ownership cleanup. Add network because proxy and IPC socket paths gained batched FD conversion/transfer and per-connection imported-handle tracking/teardown, which are independent proxy-resource changes beyond mechanical call-site edits.
